high_level_description: This image features a bottle of wine placed on top of an orange shopping bag. The bottle is labeled "La Vieille Ferme" with the year "2022" handwritten on it. The label also includes the phrase "PRODUIT DE FRANCE," indicating that the wine is a French product. There are two illustrations of chickens on the label, adding a rustic or farm-like theme to the design. The bottle is positioned centrally in the image, with its red cap facing upwards. The orange shopping bag underneath has white text printed on it, which appears to be promotional material for a mobile retailer named "Poorvika."
